hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in */src/*|*/tests/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; r="$d/.venv/bin/ruff"; [ -x "$r" ] || r=ruff; "$r" format --force-exclude -q "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
